    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    CopyEdit
    Represents a copy operation on a shape in the canvas.
    CopyHandler
    EventHandler implementation for copying shapes on a ShapeCanvas.
    DeleteEdit
    Represents an reversible delete operation on a MyShape within a ShapeCanvas.
    DeleteHandler
    Event handler responsible for deleting shapes from a ShapeCanvas.
    DrawEdit
    This class represents a drawing action on a ShapeCanvas that can be undone or redone.
    DrawHandler
    The DrawHandler class manages mouse events during the creation of a new shape on a ShapeCanvas.
    Edit
    The Edit class represents an abstract editing operation that can be performed on a MyShape object within a ShapeCanvas.
    GroupEdit
    The GroupEdit class represents an edit operation for grouping shapes on a canvas.
    GroupHandler
    EventHandler implementation for creating and managing groups of shapes on a canvas.
    Line
    Line is a concrete subclass of MyShape representing a line defined by two endpoints.
    LineHandler
    Mouse event handler for drawing Line shapes on a ShapeCanvas.
    MoveEdit
    Represents an undo-able move operation on a MyShape within a ShapeCanvas.
    MoveHandler
    MoveHandler is a JavaFX EventHandler implementation that enables interactive movement of shapes on a ShapeCanvas.
    MyShape
    MyShape is an abstract base class representing a 2D shape defined by two points.
    Oval
    Oval is a concrete subclass of MyShape representing an oval defined by its bounding rectangle (two corner points).
    OvalHandler
    Mouse event handler for drawing Oval shapes on a ShapeCanvas.
    Rect
    Rect is a concrete subclass of MyShape representing a rectangle defined by two corner points.
    RectHandler
    Mouse event handler for drawing Rect shapes on a ShapeCanvas.
    ShapeCanvas
    The ShapeCanvas class provides a custom drawing surface for creating, rendering, and managing shapes in the "ShapeEditor", a JavaFX application.
    ShapeEditor
    ShapeEditor is a JavaFX-based interactive drawing application that allows users to create, edit, and manage geometric shapes such as lines, rectangles, and ovals on a canvas.
    ShapeGroup
    Represents a composite shape that groups multiple MyShape objects and allows them to be treated as a single entity.
